name: hipporag
description: Graph-based long-term memory (HippoRAG) for Claude Code: index documents into a persistent knowledge graph and retrieve multi-hop evidence.

openai_api_key.title: API key
openai_api_key.description: API key for the LLM and embedding endpoints (OpenAI by default). Stored in the system keychain.

llm_name.title: LLM
llm_name.description: LLM used for OpenIE extraction during indexing and for rag_qa answers.

embedding_model_name.title: Embedding model
embedding_model_name.description: Embedding model for passages, entities and facts.

llm_base_url.title: LLM base URL
llm_base_url.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint for the LLM, e.g. http://localhost:8000/v1. Leave empty for OpenAI.

embedding_base_url.title: Embedding base URL
embedding_base_url.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible endpoint for embeddings. Leave empty for OpenAI.
